headline: Nigeria: Listing of the Dangote mega-refinery on the stock exchange -
summary: Aliko Dangote listed his Nigerian mega oil refinery on the stock exchange on Monday morning, which he called a historic day. The refinery is intended to become the largest of its kind.
why: Dangote Refinery is a large privately built refinery in Lagos, and its listing gives investors direct exposure to Nigerian downstream oil and refined-product supply.
